question: Of the terms that would rescue gold, what fraction could a question-only rewriter plausibly have produced?
proxy: a winning term counts as guessable-ish if it already occurs in >= 1 document of the query's shipped BM25 top-50 map; deliberately generous to reformulation

decision_rule.reformulation_viable: guessable fraction >= 0.5 on the semantic cohort
decision_rule.reformulation_cannot_win: guessable fraction <= 0.25 -- the rescuing vocabulary is incidental to the gold document, so a rewriter would have to know the answer; the document-side producer is the right shape
